case.narrative: All of a sudden when I started my car, the lights flickered constantly, the power steering failed, and it blew my starter and fairly new battery. I was so scared; I thought it was going to catch on fire because it smelled burnt. And I was on [XXX] in Hubbard Ohio, and I was trying to get to [XXX]  and safety to which I did. THANK Goodness for AAA. I was told this happened because of a plug in wiring to heat or warm the washer fluid.  It is available for inspection.  My safety was impacted because, I had no power steering, flickering lights and smell of burnt stuff.  My problem was fixed by an independent shop.  My vehicle was not inspected by a GM dealer or my insurance.  Was inspected by an independent shop that it was towed to.  Warnings prior to incident:  I would turn the ignition and nothing. But that would only happen several weeks apart.  I thought maybe the starter was going, but it was odd because it was so many weeks far apart that it would happen.  It might have been a total of 4 times since October of 2024.  During the incident,  power steering warning came on,  charging system came on and the car sounded like it was barely running. Thank you  INFORMATION REDACTED PURSUANT TO THE FREEDOM OF INFORMATION ACT (FOIA), 5 U.S.C. 552(B)(6)
